prompt:
Fast, snappy anime action-game attack shown only through body motion. The character snaps her black-and-crimson pump-action shotgun up to her hip and braces, then her whole body jolts from one heavy recoil kick that jerks the barrel sharply upward and rocks her shoulders back, her ponytail whipping; then she pumps the action with a sharp motion. Nothing visible ever comes out of the gun: no muzzle flash, no fire, no light, no smoke, no shell casings. Then she returns to the idle stance.
The character starts from the idle pose of the first frame and is back in that same idle pose at the end of the video.
Game sprite animation. The character stays in the same spot in the center of the frame at the same size, and keeps exactly the same design, proportions and flat cel-shaded art style as the first frame. Fixed locked-off camera: no zoom, no pan, no rotation. The whole character and weapon stay fully inside the frame at all times.
The background stays one perfectly flat solid pure green (#00FF00) color for the whole video: no ground, no shadow, no text.
No visual effects at all: no dust, no particles, no glow, no light effects, no motion trails.
